bootsvermietung-enge.ohNote: Hours may change due to weather; no launches during a storm warning (free rebooking or cancellation). Part of the fleet is kept for walk-ins; sauna boats booked online independently of these hours. Contact page does not label the hours with a year.
bootsvermietung-enge.req: Cash deposit and an official ID (ID card or passport) at check-in. Pedalos from age 12 without parental supervision; licence-free motorboats from 18; licence boats, Shortbreak 5.8 e-boats and Otter e-pedalos from 22. Licence boats need a licence valid for inland waters (international certificate only with a valid national licence). Life jackets on board (emergency use; children should bring their own). Billed per quarter hour at the hourly rate after return.
